method_statement: 3D linear-elastic small-displacement finite-element analysis with 10-node tetrahedra, verified against the analytical cantilever-beam benchmark. It does not model fatigue, impact, contact, bolt pretension, plasticity or casting defects, and it is not a certification of road-worthiness.
